# SuperH, big-endian, against sh-elf-as. One statement per line.
# ---- registers and their spellings
mov r0, r15
mov sp, r0
mov r15, sp
mov ix, r0
mov is, r1
mov iy, r2
MOV R3, R4
Mov.L @R1+, R2
mov r10, r11
mov r12, r13
ldc r4, r0_bank
stc r1_bank, r5
stc.l r6_bank, @-r15
ldc.l @r15+, r2_bank
# ---- immediates
mov #0, r0
mov #127, r1
mov #-1, r2
mov #255, r3
mov #0x80, r4
mov #-128, r5
mov #'A', r6
mov #1+2*3, r7
mov #(8<<2)-1, r8
add #-4, r15
add #4, r15
cmp/eq #0x55, r0
and #0xf0, r0
or #0x0f, r0
xor #0xff, r0
tst #1, r0
and.b #0x80, @(r0,gbr)
or.b #1, @(r0,gbr)
xor.b #2, @(r0,gbr)
tst.b #4, @(r0,gbr)
trapa #0
trapa #34
trapa #0xc3
# ---- scaled displacements
mov.b @(0,r1), r0
mov.b @(7,r2), r0
mov.b @(15,r3), r0
mov.w @(0,r1), r0
mov.w @(2,r2), r0
mov.w @(30,r3), r0
mov.l @(0,r1), r2
mov.l @(4,r2), r3
mov.l @(32,r4), r5
mov.l @(60,r6), r7
mov.b r0, @(1,r1)
mov.w r0, @(28,r2)
mov.l r1, @(8,r2)
mov.l r9, @(60,r10)
mov.b @(1,gbr), r0
mov.b @(200,gbr), r0
mov.w @(2,gbr), r0
mov.w @(400,gbr), r0
mov.l @(4,gbr), r0
mov.l @(1000,gbr), r0
mov.b r0, @(100,gbr)
mov.w r0, @(510,gbr)
mov.l r0, @(1020,gbr)
mov.l @(4*3,r1), r2
mov.l @( 4 , r1 ), r2
mov.l @ r1, r2
mov.l @(r0,r3), r4
mov.l r5, @(r0,r6)
# ---- mnemonics with a slash, in every case
cmp/eq r1, r2
cmp/hs r3, r4
cmp/ge r5, r6
cmp/hi r7, r8
cmp/gt r9, r10
cmp/pz r11
cmp/pl r12
cmp/str r13, r14

cmp/Gt r2, r1
fcmp/eq fr1, fr2
fcmp/gt dr2, dr4
# ---- comments and separators
nop ! a comment
nop!no space
  # a comment after indentation
rts ; nop
mov r1, r2 ; mov r3, r4 ! both
mov.l @(4,r1),r2 /* block */
# ---- aliases GNU as accepts
muls r1, r2
mulu r3, r4
bt.s 8
bf.s 8
fmov.s @r1, fr2
fmov.d dr2, @-r15
# ---- branches to absolute addresses in the section

bsr 100
bt 4

bt -0xfc
bf 0
bf/s 0x100
bt/s 2

braf r3
bsrf r4
# ---- PC-relative loads by address and by displacement
mov.l 4, r0

mov.l 1024, r2
mov.w 4, r3
mov.w 514, r4
mova 4, r0
mova 1024, r0

mova @(1020,pc), r0
